findings.resolution: A hash-bound baseline reconciles 271 curated inputs. All 173 former active files and 125 hosted exports remain byte-identical in historical directories. Native PostgreSQL/Auth/Storage reconstruction and default-ACL roundtrip reproduce 769 functions, 212 public/private tables and 5136 relation capabilities. Forward migrations repair retained runtime, Storage and posting contexts; native critical SQL and trading simulations qualify these paths.

The fresh baseline refuses an existing application schema; do not reset production or merely mark it applied.

findings.resolution: Production web configuration rejects the retired project, missing/server credentials, invalid publishable formats and wrong-project or expired legacy anon tokens. A read-only public-check workflow verifies served backend references and native public Auth health with a real public key.
findings.remaining_qualification: No authenticated Vercel or Supabase administration route is configured here. Actual environment binding, Auth redirects, user/role migration, redeployment and customer/staff acceptance remain unverified. Structural public-key checks do not prove tenant ownership.

findings.resolution: Hosted, production and unknown environments refuse local-unverified bypasses. EcoCash uses exact success statuses. WhatsApp callbacks authenticate before actions, Meta Flow requires its official raw-body HMAC, and positive settlement binds exact amount, currency, provider and registered references through an atomic financial snapshot. Late failures cannot regress PAID or enqueue duplicate initial receipts.

verification_limits: Build fixtures are synthetic and are never deployment credentials.
Local native database tests do not attest an uninspected hosted schema or production backup.
Portable iOS and aligned Android debug builds do not establish signed distribution or physical hardware acceptance.
No deployment administration identity or provider credential was invented or obtained through another project.
The source integration and native CI state must be read at the exact recorded commit; passing earlier checks is insufficient after source changes.
